entries.english_v2: It lives one kilometer underground.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the one-kilometer underground habitat and does not import the old root-feeding claim.

entries.english_v2: It likes coin-shaped objects.
entries.fidelity_comment: Keeps only the preference for coin-shaped objects; shininess and wandering are absent from the Chinese source.

entries.english_v2: Many people love this creature.
entries.fidelity_comment: Directly conveys that the creature is liked by many people without adding difficulty in raising it. Full-text review: Uses concise idiomatic English for widespread popularity.

entries.english_v2: It loves swimming in water.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves its simple love of swimming and omits the unsupported grace and flipper details.

entries.english_v2: When angry, it won't stop chasing its foe.
entries.fidelity_comment: Faithfully links its anger to a relentless pursuit of its opponent.

entries.english_v2: It guards its territory and lets no one near.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores the absolute defense of its territory without adding the old barking behavior.

entries.english_v2: This Pokémon lives in water.
entries.fidelity_comment: States only the aquatic habitat given by the reviewed Chinese source.

entries.english_v2: It is a skilled, amazingly fast swimmer.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves both its swimming skill and astonishing speed without adding a race against champions. Full-text review: Turns a noun fragment into a complete sentence.

entries.english_v2: It spots a foe and flees when it can.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores its opportunistic escape after spotting an enemy; mind reading and teleportation are not retained.

entries.english_v2: Its abilities surpass any computer.
entries.fidelity_comment: Conveys the source's responsiveness comparison with a supercomputer rather than the old perfect-memory claim. Full-text review: Matches the source ability comparison rather than inventing reaction speed.

entries.english_v2: A creature of immense strength.
entries.fidelity_comment: Keeps the Chinese source's sole fact that this is an immensely powerful creature; no belt is introduced.

entries.english_v2: It loves eating tiny bugs.
entries.fidelity_comment: Directly preserves its fondness for small insects without adding a capture method.

entries.english_v2: It sprays poison powder to halt foes.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores the poison powder that prevents enemies from moving; the old feeding behavior was unrelated.

entries.english_v2: It drifts on the sea.
entries.fidelity_comment: Keeps only the stated fact that it floats at sea, omitting unsupported acid and depth details.

entries.english_v2: Its tentacles lengthen when they pierce food.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the distinctive fact that its tentacles grow longer while piercing food.

entries.english_v2: It often roams on hillsides.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores its usual hillside habitat and does not import the old obstacle-rolling behavior.

entries.english_v2: Its diamond-hard hooves crush anything.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves both the harder-than-diamond hooves and their ability to crush anything, without inventing a numeric multiplier. Full-text review: Replaces the incomplete object 'crush all'.

entries.english_v2: It is both slow and dim-witted.
entries.fidelity_comment: Directly renders its slow movement and foolish demeanor; the five-second pain delay is not in the Chinese source.

entries.english_v2: It loves food left by other creatures.
entries.fidelity_comment: Keeps its taste for other creatures' leftovers without assigning the behavior to a different named Pokémon.

entries.english_v2: It gathers energy from power plants.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores the collection of power-plant energy and rejects the unrelated old sunspot claim.

entries.english_v2: It flies poorly but runs fast.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the contrast between weak flying ability and high running speed.

entries.english_v2: Its hard head withstands attacks.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores the hard, attack-resistant head instead of the unrelated old cold-water preference.

entries.english_v2: It lives in filthy places.
entries.fidelity_comment: States only its habitat in very dirty places without adding sludge-feeding behavior.

entries.english_v2: Its shell is hard and blocks all attacks.
entries.fidelity_comment: Faithfully preserves the source's absolute claim that the hard shell can resist any attack.

entries.english_v2: Its body spikes spread under attack.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores the body spikes spreading open under attack rather than being fired from a shell.

entries.english_v2: Its poison gas can knock people out.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the ability of its poison gas to render people unconscious; shape and composition are not asserted.

entries.english_v2: Its body is as hard as diamond.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores the diamond-like toughness of its body and omits the unrelated cave and inhabitant claims.

entries.english_v2: When it meets foes, it puts them to sleep.
entries.fidelity_comment: Keeps the ability to induce sleep on encountering enemies without adding a gaze-based mechanism.

entries.english_v2: Its huge pincers have endless strength.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the huge pincers and their limitless strength without importing a numerical force value.

entries.english_v2: It gathers huge energy to cause storms.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores the accumulation of great energy specifically to trigger storms.

entries.english_v2: It likes to move along the ground.
entries.fidelity_comment: Directly renders its preference for moving close to the ground and excludes the unrelated old birth claim.

entries.english_v2: It hurls its bone club at foes.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the use of a thrown bone club to strike enemies without adding a boomerang comparison.

entries.english_v2: Its leg stretches during a flying kick.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores the extending leg during a flying kick rather than merely praising the kick's power.

entries.english_v2: It swings its fists at superhuman speed.
entries.fidelity_comment: Directly preserves the superhuman speed of its punching fists without adding invisibility.

entries.english_v2: Its tongue paralyzes those it licks.
entries.fidelity_comment: Keeps the paralysis caused by a lick and omits the unsupported tongue measurement.

entries.english_v2: It absorbs poison gases, often causing huge blasts.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves both its absorption of varied poison gases and the frequent large explosions that result.

entries.english_v2: It emits poison gas for a long time.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores the prolonged release of poison gas; growth from gas, dust, and bacteria is absent from the source.

entries.english_v2: It moves nimbly and swims freely at sea.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves agile movement and free swimming at sea without adding a direction or anatomical mechanism.

entries.english_v2: In fall, it is often seen spawning in rivers.
entries.fidelity_comment: Keeps the autumn timing, frequent river appearance, and spawning purpose without adding upstream movement.

entries.english_v2: Its gem shines in seven colors.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores the seven-colored light from its bodily gem and omits the old communication theory.

entries.english_v2: It reacts fast, moves well and has sharp claws.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves its keen reactions, agile movement, and sharp claws; no illusion ability is introduced.

entries.english_v2: It likes to hide in flames.
entries.fidelity_comment: States only its preference for hiding in flames, not a volcanic birth or flame-covered body.

entries.english_v2: The horn on its head is fearsome.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores the formidable horn on its head and rejects the unrelated old pincer attack.

entries.english_v2: Looks weak, but legends say it once was mighty.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the contrast between its weak appearance and legendary past power; ubiquity is not asserted.

entries.english_v2: It carries people on its back while swimming.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores its ability to carry people across water on its back and omits the unrelated mind-reading claim.

entries.english_v2: It transforms to mimic its foe.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the transformation used to imitate an enemy without adding a DNA mechanism.

entries.english_v2: It can generate vast electric power.
entries.fidelity_comment: Keeps only its ability to produce great electrical energy; ions and lightning are not added.

entries.english_v2: Its living body was made by a program.
entries.fidelity_comment: Directly preserves its program-made living body without importing cyberspace travel.

entries.english_v2: It has sharp teeth and likes eating shells.
entries.fidelity_comment: Restores the sharp teeth and appetite for shells; the old heavy-shell hunting claim is unrelated.

entries.english_v2: It swims fast and has sickle-like claws.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves its fast swimming and sickle-shaped claws without adding fluid-draining behavior.

entries.english_v2: A ferocious ancient Pokémon.
entries.fidelity_comment: Keeps the Chinese source's sole description of a ferocious ancient Pokémon; no throat attack is added.

entries.english_v2: A legendary bird summons fierce lightning.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the legendary bird and the immense lightning it can cause without adding storm appearances.

entries.english_v2: A legendary bird can burn anything.
entries.fidelity_comment: Directly renders the legendary bird's ability to burn everything rather than describing only wing flames.

entries.english_v2: Few have seen it. Its mind surpasses a human's.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves both its extreme rarity and intelligence exceeding a human's, correcting the old equality claim.

entries.english_v2: A wondrous Pokémon almost no one has seen.
entries.fidelity_comment: Faithfully describes a wondrous Pokémon that almost nobody has ever seen.

entries.english_v2: One of the three great kings, lord of fire.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the custom Chinese title as one of three great rulers and lord of fire; no unrelated named-Pokémon lore is imported.

entries.english_v2: One of the three great kings, lord of water.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the custom Chinese title as one of three great rulers and lord of water; purification lore is omitted.

entries.english_v2: A mysterious Hoenn Pokémon rules the seabed.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the mysterious being, its Hoenn origin, and its title as king of the seabed without importing the old downpour lore. Full-text review: Turns the source title into a complete natural Pokédex sentence.

entries.english_v2: A mysterious Hoenn Pokémon rules the sky.
entries.fidelity_comment: Preserves the mysterious being, its Hoenn origin, and its title as king of the sky without importing the old ozone lore. Full-text review: Turns the source title into a complete natural Pokédex sentence.
